stories.title: Seth Meyers on Trump canceling $1bn in federal funds: ‘Is he adding a waterslide to the reflecting pool?’
stories.summary: US late-night hosts discussed President Donald Trump’s relationship with technology leaders, a Washington Maha summit and the White House’s new AI-powered website. Seth Meyers also joked about Trump cancelling $1 billion in federal funds, while the coverage noted another instance of the president appearing to fall asleep on live television.

stories.title: How American political campaigns are using AI – and what they’re spending on the tools
stories.summary: New US campaign-finance disclosures show which political candidates, parties and committees are paying for AI tools and how much they are spending. The findings, examined in the book Rewiring Democracy, offer a view of how artificial intelligence is beginning to influence American politics despite politicians saying little publicly about their use of it.

stories.title: Who’s your Uber driver on the phone to? Welcome to the long, long diaspora phone call
stories.summary: Long phone calls can provide companionship for cab drivers and others doing arduous, solitary work. The Guardian article frames these conversations as a place for immigrants to navigate the dislocations of diaspora life and considers whom Uber drivers may be speaking with while on the road.
